Spending Instruments

From the ORA eTraining module "Post Award Quick Guide" (lesson 4 of 9).
How to Spend Your Money
The PI may spend award funds through a variety of mechanisms at MSU. These are summarized in PI Handbook #3 on pages 21-22. The PI must: Work with RFA to establish an award account with a Banner index and fund. Ensure a Purchasing Card (P-Card) is linked to the index/fund if needed. Submit a WorkFlow request for access to your project budget in Banner.
Complete the content above before moving on.

Summary
Establishing the Award Account
Has a Post-Award Briefing with the ORA been completed? Once ORA has a copy of the NOA in hand they will contact the project PI to schedule this meeting. No spending can occur on a project without this so be sure to make yourself available. Once the Post-Award Briefing has been completed, has notice been sent to the Restricted Funds Accounting (RFA) team? Has RFA set up the account and assigned a grant accountant? RFA needs to be notified that a Post-Award Briefing has occurred so that they can initiate actions in Banner to establish your award account. At that time, RFA will also assign the grant accountant you will work with for the duration of your award.
P-Card Access
Does the PI have a MSU Purchasing Card (P-Card)? If yes : Submit a request for the new index to be attached to the current P-Card through the Purchasing Card Office . If no: Submit a request for a new P-Card through the Purchasing Card Office if necessary. The PI (or other assigned cardholder) will need to receive P-Card training. Whether or not a PI receives a P-Card for their project is at the discretion of the MSU Purchasing Card Office.
Banner WorkFlow Access
Has the PI's supervisor submitted a WorkFlow request for the PI to gain access to their budget in Banner? Once Banner access is granted, the award funds may begin to be spent according to the budget/budget justification.
Knowledge check: True or False: As soon as you receive a copy of your Notice of Award you may begin spending on your project.
  - True  [incorrect]
  - False  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  Explanation: There are multiple reasons why this answer is false. First, your Notice of Award typically arrived before the start date of your project. Here at MSU, pre-award spending is typically not allowed. Additionally, RFA and ORA need to provide you with a post award briefing, and establish the project budget in Banner, before you can spend on your project.
Knowledge check: True or False: The Purchasing Card Office will automatically add your new budget to your existing purchasing card once ORA has received your Notice of Award.
  - True  [incorrect]
  - False  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  Explanation: You need to submit documentation to the P-Card Office to add the new Banner index associated with your project to your P-Card.
